{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask]
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by channel
table = pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['converted'], normalize='index')

effect = table.loc['email', 1] - table.loc['paid_search', 1]

# Print only the numbers that will be in the evidence — no strings, no constants
print(num_qa)
print(len(df_clean))
print(table.loc['email', 1])
print(table.loc['paid_search', 1])
print(effect)"}
